newsitem.title: USA: IPO PRICING-World prices below range at $6.
newsitem.headline: IPO PRICING-World prices below range at $6.

text.p: Company Name World of Science Inc

NOTE: The number of shares was lowered for the initial public offering in World of Science Inc to 2.45 million shares from 2.6 million shares originally. The original 2.6 million shares were comprised of 1.6 million shares being sold by the company and the remaining one million shares by selling shareholders. The 2.45 million shares are comprised of 1.6 million shares sold by the company and 850,000 shares by selling shareholders.
